mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST at 1256.0 and RSAFS at 526540.0 as of 2019-10-31
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative SPX 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 2.5%) triggers monetary tightening expectations, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5% (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP contraction (GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized) signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, reducing corporate activity and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO at 108.6714 and HOUST at 1256.0 as of 2019-10-31
failure_condition: Joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce negative SPX 5-day returns in at least 60% of cases (5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during contraction phases reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 (5-year rolling window).
